es-MX.name: Mapa de Essma World
es-MX.description: Mapa ilustrado del Rancho de Essma y sus futuras regiones.

source.referencePolicy: The five repository reference images informed only broad, non-copied art direction: warm Sonoran golden light, adobe and wood materials, child-friendly landscape readability. They are not embedded, derived from, or shipped as runtime media.

prompts.landscape: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: responsive web-game world map backdrop (landscape 16:9), project-bound raster art. Primary request: create an entirely original, richly painted but clear children's storybook map of a warm Sonoran ranch region at late-afternoon golden light. This is background art only, with NO labels, NO lettering, NO logos, NO UI, NO watermark. Scene/backdrop: a wide aerial three-quarter view with six clearly separated landmark spaces joined by a gently winding dusty trail: center-lower ranch home with red adobe house, small barn, corral and green mesquite trees; upper-left cactus desert with rock mesas; upper-right a compact colorful pueblo of adobe buildings; lower-right dense mesquite grove; far-right small blue oasis with palms; lower-left valley filled with wildflowers. Leave breathing room and uncluttered open ground around each landmark so web hotspots can be overlaid. Subject: landscape only; no characters, people, animals, signs, maps, icons, or text. Style/medium: original hand-painted children’s-book environment illustration, tactile adobe, sun-baked clay, wood, woven textures and soft paper grain; rounded friendly forms with precise readable silhouettes. Composition/framing: wide 16:9 composition, ranch as prominent center destination; distribute landmark clusters near edges; keep all essential landmarks away from outer 6% crop safe margin so a mobile crop still reads. Lighting/mood: optimistic golden Sonoran afternoon; dappled, cozy and inviting. Color palette: sand beige, terracotta, marigold, cactus and mesquite green, cobalt water, desert-pink sky. Constraints: design must be original, culturally respectful, child-friendly, visually legible at small sizes; no text whatsoever; no third-party characters, logos, copied layouts, or named-studio imitation. Avoid: UI panels, buttons, text, border frame, watermark, labels, title, compass, topographic overlay, realistic photo look, scary elements.

accessibilityReview.notes: Landmarks are not the only means of identification: semantic labelled HTML hotspots and status feedback sit above the decorative backdrop. No generated text is embedded in either image.
